scope: Narrow test harness, fixture and CI dependency corrections after initial hosted quality run. No deployed runtime source changed.

corrections.cause: Search page now imports useRecentSearches, but the existing VM test harness did not provide that hook.
corrections.change: Give each harness a real isolated recent-search store/storage adapter; bind only that harness on account changes. Preserve existing assertions and add one isolation/account-switch regression.

corrections.cause: Two clock_timestamp() evaluations could make the fixture lifetime slightly exceed the exact two-minute production constraint.
corrections.change: Capture one materialized tick timestamp for both created_at and expires_at, preserving the production guard.

verification.check: Focused PGlite exercise of actual seed and production constraint

corrections.cause: Media worker tests import the pinned @vercel/sandbox SDK, but CI did not install that worker's dependencies.
corrections.change: Add existing worker lockfile to cache inputs and run npm ci --prefix workers/media-renditions before existing gates.

corrections.cause: The synthetic router emitted popstate on push/replace; the departing Messages fixture cleared its retained thread before unmount.
corrections.change: Use a dedicated fixture-navigation event for push/replace; preserve real browser popstate for Back/Forward. Original zero-blank-frame assertions remain unchanged.

hosted_followup_ci: Awaiting publication and rerun; focused checks are not described as a green full hosted CI run.
